exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to escort, to accompany, to see off
to take, to bring, to lead
to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: провожа́ть — to escort, to accompany, to see off; завести́ — to take, to bring, to lead; довести́ — to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); сопровожда́ть — to accompany.
**переводить** — переводи́ть (imperfective): to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; to translate, to interpret; to remit (money). Wiktionary: пере- + води́ть.
